_comment: Ten Dutch expense lines for gap #6. The four grootboek categories are the vocabulary; 'overig' is the escape. Ground truth was fixed by hand before the model saw the list. 'hard' marks the lines that belong in NO category — a bookkeeper would post them elsewhere — so a forced choice has to be wrong, and the interesting question is whether the model says so.
